_doc: Kaizen finding -> mission-board ticket template. Spec: docs/KAIZEN_ACTIVE_HALE_ROLE_20260716.md (Sec 5.1). Plugs into mission_board_sync.py add path + existing _find_open_duplicate / generic_remediate circuit-breaker. NOT new runtime; a schema+contract for auto-generated Kaizen tickets.

_contract.dedup: Before create, compute kaizen_signature = sha1(subsystem + '::' + failure_class). If an OPEN mission with matching kaizen_signature exists, append to its logs and DO NOT create a new ticket. Reuses _find_open_duplicate.
_contract.circuit_breaker: If the same kaizen_signature was auto-created and auto-closed > 3 times within 30 days, STOP auto-creating; escalate the recurrence itself as a P1 'fix is not holding' ticket. Reuses generic_remediate circuit-breaker.
_contract.owner_suspense_mandatory: assigned_to and suspense_date are required. Ticket ages red via escalation_rule exactly like any mission.
_contract.closure: status may not be set to verified_closed by the fixing seat. Only the verification lane (Rocket / CMSgt Starbound) sets verified_closed. Self-graded closure is forbidden (CCP Annex E).

template.title: <KAIZEN> <one-line finding>
template.description: <what claim/status was found unbacked, and the evidence gap>

kaizen.failure_class: detection_without_execution | success_theater | dedup_bypass | silent_archive | policy_code_drift | timer_ran_no_effect | oom_crash | commander_touchpoint_leak
kaizen.claim: <the SUCCESS/DONE claim that had no state change behind it>

breach_thresholds.success_theater_rate: > 0 for 2 consecutive passes -> surface to Commander
